---
title: Manage Games
description: Edit game rules or delete promotional activities to refresh user engagement.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1374" height="759" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Loyalty App > Games > Game List.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="284" height="171" style="width: 284px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Click to a game to view details or delete a specific game.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="691" height="290" style="width: 691px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3. Modify game details or delete game.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="471" height="282" style="width: 471px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
